content.title: [FR] FR-032 资源负荷、物料缺口与提醒
content.body:
## 需求
范围：P0；关联流程：BP-05/07；页面：PG-07；开始提供：R2；完整提供：R7。
前置功能：FR-020/022/024。
• 按当前已支持范围显示设备忙闲、模具占用、人员需求、空间占用和物料缺口；从汇总转到任务和原始数据。
• 显示订单延后、模拟到料未满足、输入缺失等提醒。优先实现具体数量和原因，不以复杂经营指标看板作为排程前置。

## 验收追踪
验收用例：AC-06/07/10/14/26。

来源：需求分析与设计说明书 v0.3，第 6 章；状态：基线需求，具体实现状态待跟踪。


## Patrol delivery and immediate continuation
Owner APS-Dev delivery dlv_8810cfa4-eeb4-416f-978a-2c62c9a25ab3. Immediate continuation after FR034 completed/Dev idle/no queuedduplicate. Openissue scan no confirmed unresolved productdefect; no three exhausted-round blocked tasks. FR020/022/024 supportedsource prerequisites available in72276614c0de122a6c45688e4f7b3cd7fbb129ed. Original AC06/07/10/14/26 resourcebusy/idle/occupation/demand/space/materialshortage/lateorder/conditionalarrival/missinginput alerts and summary->task->originalinput assigned; concrete quantities/units/reasons and truthful unknowns. Preserve frozen/currentfacts distinction/no doublecounts and unresolved policy boundaries. Container tests/build/CSV/browser wherepossible/ordinarypush/fullSHA/report required, no parallelcard/publication.
